maria (AE): Acme wants a Private deployment POC. Goals: keep original client source IP for audit logs, avoid recurring EIP/NAT costs if possible, and a short outbound allowlist. They also asked whether PrivateLink per-account or TGW + central proxy is better for multi-account. @sanjay can you list options?

sanjay (SE): Two common patterns: 1) PrivateLink per-account + in-VPC proxy: easy to set up, endpoint ENIs will appear as source to our connector unless you proxy & inject X-Forwarded-For. 2) TGW + central proxy in a spoke: preserves 5-tuple if you avoid SNAT and is cheaper for heavier traffic but needs central ops. For strict source-ip in our logs, have the proxy add authenticated X-Forwarded-For for POC.

anya (Customer NetOps): If we host a proxy in each account and use interface endpoints, will we avoid NAT charges?

sanjay (SE): Interface endpoints eliminate NAT Gateway hourly/data charges but AWS charges for endpoints per-hour and per-GB. If traffic is small (POC), PrivateLink likely cheaper. If large, TGW with customer-hosted proxies can reduce per-GB NAT costs. Redwood does not bill for AWS primitives; we bill on inference usage.

tom (NetEng): Ask customer to share: spoke CIDRs, endpoint subnet IDs, SG rules, and whether TGW exists. Sample SG note for proxy: inbound TCP/443 from app subnets, outbound TCP/443 to Redwood connector IP ranges (we'll provide region list). If using PrivateLink, allow to the endpoint ENI IPs.

security (GRC): We'll prefill network answers on the security questionnaire: TLS 1.2+, mTLS or API keys, VPC Flow Logs enabled, restrict to provided subnets, customer-managed KMS optional. Please attach the questionnaire.

maria (AE): I'll send a short checklist and a POC estimate. @sanjay can you follow up with per-region IP ranges and a one-page diagram?

sanjay (SE): Will do — also provide a one-paragraph POC runbook: 1) Customer: create endpoints or TGW routes and open firewall; 2) Customer: deploy optional proxy to preserve src IP; 3) Redwood: share connector IPs, validate mTLS/API key; 4) Joint: run curl tests and confirm X-Forwarded-For and flow logs.

deploy-bot: connectivity-check queued for thread 2812345678 — paste curl output here when ready. :robot_face:

anya (Customer NetOps): Thanks — we'll try interface endpoints + app proxy first and attach the questionnaire.

maria (AE): Thanks everyone, looping back with pricing blurb and docs link.
